title: 上海高考翻译背诵-63-26一模

items.zh: 我们都要谨记，身心健康重于一切。
items.en: We all should bear in mind that physical and mental health outweigh everything else.

items.zh: 谁能抑制住想要抱一抱这只圆滚滚，惹人喜爱的小奶猫的欲望呢？
items.en: Who can curb the desire to hug such a chubby and adorable tiny kitten?

items.zh: 这位教授为培养我国自己的音乐人才呕心沥血四十余年，实在令人心生敬意。
items.en: For over forty years, the professor has devoted tireless effort to nurturing our nation’s musical talent, a commitment that inspires our greatest respect.

items.zh: 初冬的午后，我漫步在这所知名学府的校园，踏着铺满落叶的草坪，享受着书香带来的内心安宁。
items.en: On an early winter afternoon, I was wandering around the campus of the prestigious university, treading on the lawn covered with fallen leaves, enjoying the inner peace brought by the scent of books.
